trends.what: A curated directory of hundreds of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's a go-to resource for developers building side projects, integrations, and prototypes, making it a perpetual favorite.

trends.what: An open-source platform offering free coding lessons, projects, and certifications in web development, data science, and more.
trends.why: It remains a top destination for self-taught programmers and career switchers, especially with the growing demand for tech skills.

trends.what: A massive collection of freely accessible programming books, tutorials, and educational resources across many languages.
trends.why: With rising costs of education, this repo is a treasure trove for learners seeking free, high-quality technical knowledge.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed to be fully customizable and private.
trends.why: The push for local, private AI assistants is heating up, and this project's 'lobster way' branding adds a fun, memorable twist.

trends.what: Interactive roadmaps and guides that visually chart out career paths and learning steps for developers at all levels.
trends.why: As tech career paths become more complex, developers rely on clear visual guides to navigate skills and job roles.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents generate code with a 'lazy senior dev' mindset, prioritizing minimal, simple solutions.
trends.why: It taps into the growing desire for AI that writes pragmatic, maintainable code rather than over-engineered solutions.

trends.what: A fullscreen, mouse-interactive terminal UI and harness for running coding agents, built by SpaceXAI.
trends.why: It offers a polished, extensible developer experience for AI-assisted coding, appealing to power users who want more control.

trends.what: A pure C, zero-dependency runtime that runs frontier Mixture-of-Experts AI models on local hardware by streaming experts from disk.
trends.why: It democratizes access to large AI models by enabling them to run on modest hardware, a major breakthrough for local AI.
